input_construction_audit.cast_authority: Installed CPU torch FP32→BF16→FP32, independent of producer NumPy bit-round implementation.

c0-o1.source_scope: Previously observed input discrepancy only; no later outcome arrays read.

c1-o0.source_scope: Previously observed input discrepancy only; no later outcome arrays read.

inputs.scope: Known selected N1/P1 sources. Low own direction at unit scale is an already observed input control; other three edited inputs newly constructed. No semantic correspondence asserted across prompt coordinates.

original_expectations.construction: rho=min(RMS(delta_c1-o0),RMS(delta_c0-o1)); X_rd=BF16_RNE(FP32(N_r+(rho/RMS(delta_d))*delta_d)), with FP64 scaling/addition and no post-round retuning. Record actual norms, support and cosine after casting.
original_expectations.consumer: Qualified native VAE renders all six sealed mathematical terminal latents before native denoising, then all six native terminal latents. Compare raw fixed-coordinate RGB responses and complete latent responses.

forecasts.basis: Declared project dependency equations; receiver conditioning, IDs and clock remain unchanged.
forecasts.observable: For each of four edits, mathematical and native project text/context/RoPE changed-minus-own-sham responses
forecasts.prediction: Exactly zero in all regenerated fields independent of latent; image may change.

forecasts.basis: Tentative receiver-sensitivity explanation of prior diagonal contrast; direction and receiver were previously confounded. A miss is informative.
forecasts.observable: Native pass1/post-single19 image response RMS divided by actual installed latent-change RMS, separately for both source directions
forecasts.prediction: c1-o0 receiver exceeds c0-o1 receiver for each source direction.

forecasts.basis: Modest transfer conjecture from prior two diagonal response directions, not an accuracy guarantee.
forecasts.observable: Cosine of full mathematical changed-minus-sham and native changed-minus-sham image responses at pass1/post-single19 in each corner
forecasts.prediction: Positive in each of four corners; undefined for a zero response.

original_expectations.mechanics: Source identity, model/numeric policy, exact input installation, receiver-owned closure, finite work and custody are integrity contracts. Response accuracy, cosine, image errors and rank/sign checks are observations only.
original_expectations.numerical_predictions: All six complete84-transition mathematical programs, input manifests, full output descriptors, retained landmark arrays and final latents will seal before any new native/VAE execution. They are the detailed vector forecasts, independently of these coarse rank/sign conjectures.
original_expectations.semantic_scope: Fixed numerical latent coordinates shared by the model. No direction is asserted to mean color, object identity or placement.
original_expectations.source_scope: Two previously selected N1 receivers and their observed P1-N1 input directions; known downstream outcomes inform the tentative rank conjecture. This is not fresh-seed replication. Low own-direction at unit scale repeats an already observed input as a positive control; the other three edited inputs are newly constructed.

scope: Known selected contexts, three newly constructed edited inputs and one known input control. Finite responses include receiver-dependent BF16 installation. Raw-coordinate contrasts are not semantic labels; no independent new recurrence recomputation during this reduction.
